statement: Every INSERT reported successful during rolling restart has a durable commit witness and becomes visible from every reachable node after guarded recovery.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.

Treat stat-gate-20260801T231601Z and its run-13 report as immutable outer evidence: five successful INSERT keys were absent from b01ff99f after the 120-second guarded-recovery visibility window, while their state on the other four nodes and their durable commit state remain unknown because the oracle stopped at the first node failure. Do not rewrite that SAFETY_VIOLATED verdict or infer a narrower cause from absence alone.

Before changing runtime behavior, reuse the existing acknowledged-write ledger and extend its receipts with accepting node, acceptance timestamp, partition, leader, term, and a durable commit witness. Extend the existing visibility oracle to inspect every reachable node and retain a complete per-key/per-node matrix even after the first failure. Reuse the existing recovery barriers, failure bundles, and analyzers; add no parallel ledger, oracle, recovery gate, or safety classifier.

Build a deterministic in-process replay of the run-13 sequence in which 2623e7e1 is restarting, 9c847442 accepts the affected write sequence, guarded recovery completes, and b01ff99f is queried. The replay must distinguish absent on every node as acknowledgement-before-durable-commit, present on the accepting leader or only some replicas as replication/recovery catch-up failure, and durably present but unreadable from b01ff99f as routing/read-authority visibility failure.

A successful INSERT response is permitted only after the canonical write owner can attach an authoritative durable commit witness for that operation identity, partition, leader, and term. Retry, redirect, restart, leader change, recovery, and receipt projection must preserve operation identity and must not synthesize success from enqueue, send, local apply, cache visibility, or an uncommitted leader-local observation.

After the existing guarded-recovery barriers, the oracle must query every reachable node for every acknowledged key, retain successes, absences, retryable failures, route/authority witnesses, and completion timestamps, and emit one canonical classification without short-circuiting. A node query failure is oracle blindness or a typed visibility failure; it is never permission to omit the remaining nodes.

Once the deterministic receipt matrix identifies the first broken boundary, change only that canonical owner path and its direct/tail consumers. Reuse Message Group write routing, Raft durability/commit machinery, query retry routing, guarded recovery, and current operation identity. Do not add a second write path, replica truth, cache authority, acknowledgement owner, repair loop, timer, timeout increase, or recovery exemption.

After the evidence identifies the boundary, model requested -> durable -> acknowledged -> restart -> recovered -> visible in TLA+, including an acknowledgement-before-durability mutant that must violate the safety property. Keep the existing Alloy corpus green and extend Alloy only if evidence identifies replica-set cardinality or ownership allocation as the deciding boundary. Model evidence supplements but never replaces deterministic or live proof.

The deterministic reproduction must fail on current or reverted bytes at the invariant-producing layer and pass only with the correction. Prove receipt projection, owner commit/ack ordering, retry/leader-change identity, guarded recovery, every-node visibility, failure-bundle/analyzer consumption, and the direct query-routing tail without skips, test-only paths, feature flags, or weakened assertions.

Only after deterministic red-on-revert proof, focused recovery and routing tests, model checks, static guardrails, and independent exact-candidate verification may this child spend one bounded live engagement check. The child must not run N=15; it returns the immutable engagement result to the representative parent, which alone may run a fresh clean fixed-code N=15 certification.

Restart-infrastructure, admin-reachability, admission, placement, and other liveness residuals remain queued behind this safety invariant unless they prevent measurement of the deterministic safety boundary. Do not tune liveness, workload, resource limits, protocol timers, the 120-second visibility barrier, or the sealed statistical bar in this Quest.
